text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NASA-047","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING RAW MATERIAL HEAT TREATMENT FINISH COMPOMENT UT DP+UT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N2 requires penetrant (DP) and ultrasonic (UT/MPI) inspection on the finish component, but the title block specifies heat treatment \"HARDENED\" and note N1 confirms hardening to 32-35 HRC. Because penetrant and magnetic-particle inspections must be performed before final hardening or plating (IZBP) to detect surface defects that subsequent processing could mask, a separate note is required stating these inspections occur before finish machining/treatment.","recommended_correction":"Add a note explicitly requiring DP, UT, and MPI inspections to be completed before hardening and final surface treatment."},{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : HARDENED HARDNESS & DEPTH : UPTO 32-35 HRC.THROUGH FINISH & DEPTH : IZBP TEST COUPON SIZE : ⌀40 (20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"material","page":1,"quote":"EN-24"}],"comment":"Note N1 includes \"WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE\" for a solid EN-24 shaft with no weld symbols, welded features, or fabrication geometry shown anywhere in the drawing. This introduces contradictory fabrication requirements for a purely machined part, which can confuse manufacturing and quality control.","recommended_correction":"Remove the weld class reference from note N1, as no welding is depicted or applicable to this shaft."}]}
